estimates.assumptions: Directly using the supplied measurement of 500g as the edible mass for the entire white bread mix ingredient line; no estimation needed.

12 rashers/strips of typical bacon; each rasher ~30g raw edible weight (standard UK rasher size 25-35g), total 360g. Copying supplied knownCaloriesPer100g exactly; assumes this value is for the raw preparation state as listed.

A 'knob' of fresh ginger is typically a small 10-20g piece; using 15g as realistic average peeled edible weight in a recipe context for 12 buns. Copying supplied knownCaloriesPer100g exactly; assumes this is for raw peeled ginger.
